# GitHub Copilot repository instructions

Read and follow the repository's `AGENTS.md` as the shared source of agent instructions. Before a PowerShell change, read `docs/Powershell guidelines.md`; for `outcalget`, also read `outcalget/AGENTS.md` and `docs/outcalget/README.md`.

For `embelish.ps1` or `sendshards.ps1`, read `embelish/AGENTS.md` and `docs/embelish/README.md` or `docs/sendshards/README.md`, respectively. Preserve interactive 7-Zip password handling and Sendshards' frozen plans, verified resumable Git transfer, persisted budget and active security controls. Do not run real archive operations or pushes to validate documentation.

- Preserve the user's requested scope and unrelated working-tree changes.
- Target Windows PowerShell 5.1 and preserve established native behavior, CLI/configuration/output contracts and corporate security controls.
- Keep executable implementation in the existing scripts and documentation under `docs/<tool>/`. Preserve functional directives and synchronize Markdown with native external help XML.
- Use isolated, proportionate development checks; distinguish current results from historical evidence. Linux/PowerShell 7 and simulated COM do not establish Windows/Outlook acceptance.
- Keep credentials, calendar content and sensitive runtime state out of commits and responses. Do not execute real exports or `update-calendar.ps1` during development; that helper deletes, commits and pushes calendar data.
- Report changes, checks and remaining target limitations. Do not commit or push repository changes unless requested.

Apply the more specific instructions in `.github/instructions/outcalget.instructions.md` when editing the exporter, its helper or documentation.

Apply `.github/instructions/embelish.instructions.md` to the archive/transfer scripts and their documentation. The shared `AGENTS.md` files remain the full behavior policy.
